name: player_actions_anim
title: Player GetAnimAction and IsPlayerActionActive 1-10 every game loop while drawing, aiming, firing, reloading (9mm, .357, Cowboy Repeater), sneaking, jumping, throwing grenades, swinging and blocking (docs/spec-notes/anim-state.md §5; about 2 min)
start: nvfstrip (any save the player can fight in). Travels to a Goodsprings house (GSHouseInterior03, nobody inside), god mode, gives the weapons; never saved; unattended (capture_run.py --save nvfstrip). Each sample is (GetAnimAction + 1) x 2048 + the bits of IsPlayerActionActive 1..10 (index i is bit i-1).
